findings.message: The new delivery assertions require IDs such as E20261001c0ffee00:S001. This pins the removed work-item scheme instead of the approved EPIC-/STORY- artifact IDs and would reject a delivery graph using the unified identity scheme. Update the grouping assertions to use artifact IDs while checking the anchor separately.
findings.expectationRef: PLAN t15: move delivery graph/read identity consumers to the new module; LLD summary: delete the second work-item scheme and use one identity module.

findings.message: The hash documentation introduces an exception allowing SPEC and ISSUE hashes of at least 8 characters. The approved contract requires 16 lowercase hex characters for these kinds too; their distinction is that they use their own run hash.
findings.expectationRef: LLD contractDetails.api[ArtifactIds.make].preconditions: epicHash is 16 lowercase hex characters (SPEC and ISSUE take their own run hash).

findings.message: The new Meta type declares createdAt?: string and epicCreatedAt?: string without explicit `| undefined`. Add it to both optional properties to follow the documented strict optional-property convention.

Every supplied changed symbol has an empty testsReaching array, so each is a not-exercised gap under the required coverage rule. All 34 promised tests are present and recorded as passing; those results do not establish the missing reachability edges. This finding concerns the supplied coverage grounding, not an assertion that those tests are missing or failing.
